title: Build Quality and Solid Feel
summary: Feedback about build quality centers on a generally solid, well-built feel, with one explicit complaint about quality relative to price and many comments that are favorable in wording but classified as undetermined.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle as well engineered, very well built, and notably free of flaws.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the build quality is poor for the vehicle's cost.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments describe the vehicle as solidly built or highlight build quality, but the sample does not provide enough context to classify them more precisely.

limitations: Many fragments use favorable wording but are labeled undetermined, which limits how firmly the overall sentiment can be interpreted.
All examples come from the same model and country, so this topic summary is narrow in scope.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews.
